small_guidance: The conv_transpose3d_kernel is memory-bound at 77% throughput but achieves only 41% occupancy due to 96 registers/thread. Reduce register pressure: drop BLOCK_OC to 8 or 16 with smaller BLOCK_SP (32-64), and accumulate in tl.float32 with fewer live tiles. Also hoist the IC loop outermost and reuse loaded x_val across all (kd,kh,kw) by restructuring loop order so the inner (kd,kh,kw) reuses one x load per IC. Add configs with num_warps=2 and num_stages=3 to overlap loads.
large_guidance: Redesign as input-stationary scatter-add: launch one program per (N, IC tile, input-spatial tile) and scatter the input*weight outer product into output positions. Since stride=2, each input voxel contributes to KD*KH*KW=27 output positions with no overlap (because stride>=kernel-1 for valid positions). This avoids the gather divisibility checks ((id_num - id_idx*SD)==0) that cause warp divergence and register bloat. Alternatively, flatten to a GEMM: treat conv-transpose as W[IC,OC*KD*KH*KW] @ X[IC, N*ID*IH*IW] followed by a col2im scatter epilogue, leveraging tl.dot for tensor-core-style mma on the IC=16 reduction. Fuse the BatchNorm (folded scale/shift from running stats) and the spatial mean-subtract into the conv epilogue by computing per-(N,OC) channel sums in a second pass or via atomic accumulation.
